component.name: Weft
component.summary: A voxel sandbox engine written in Rust

description.p: Weft is a voxel sandbox engine written in Rust. The game itself is a mod, built only on the public SDK: it has no private hooks into the engine, so anything it does, another mod can do or change. Weft is not a Minecraft clone and does not read Minecraft worlds; it plays like one and borrows its numbers where that makes sense. Weft is only available in English, Russian, and French
